title: Days of the Week and Times of Day
seo_title: Days and Times of Day – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Know morning, afternoon, evening and night; the days of the week; and the order of daily events. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: morning, afternoon and night, the order of daily events and the days of the week. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • We wake up in the morning and sleep at night.
  • The days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
  • Yesterday was before today. Tomorrow comes after today.

Examples

Example

Today is Tuesday. What day is tomorrow?

Tuesday, then Wednesday

Answer: Wednesday

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up yesterday and tomorrowYesterday has gone. Tomorrow is coming.
Missing a daySay all 7 days in order.
Putting events in the wrong orderThink: what do you do first?

items.q: Put these in order for a school day: eat lunch, go to bed, eat dinner.
c: Eat dinner, eat lunch, go to bed
Go to bed, eat dinner, eat lunch
Eat lunch, eat dinner, go to bed
Eat lunch, go to bed, eat dinner
items.e: Start with the earliest thing: Eat lunch, eat dinner, go to bed.

items.q: Which day comes after Monday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Monday comes Tuesday.

items.q: Which day comes before Wednesday?
items.e: Count back one day from Wednesday: Tuesday.

items.q: Which day comes after Tuesday?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, then Monday again. After Tuesday comes Wednesday.

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: The days go in order: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. The missing day is Wednesday.

items.q: How many days are in one week?
